messages.subject: Notes: Leadership meeting 10 March
messages.body:
Liebe Alle,

Notes: Leadership meeting, Tuesday 10 March, 14:00, meeting room Rotterdam

Attendees: Marta, Dev, Helen, Priya, Tomás, Aisha, Lena (notes)

Discussed:
- v3 status: Priya reported the bug count is trending down but launch risk is real; more on this next week
- Payments: Helen presented the updated fee comparison (PayForge 2.9% + €0.30 vs Ledgerly 2.3% + €0.25, ≈ €1,860/month saved on ≈ €310k processed). Dev confirmed integration is 2-3 engineer-weeks plus one shadow billing cycle, and that this no longer collides with v3 if we start soon. Tomás flagged that Redline is now explicitly asking for local-currency invoicing ahead of the renewal.
- Office: nothing new, sublet question postponed

Agreed:
- Direction of travel on payments is Ledgerly, pending Marta's final go and a cutover date
- Sales will keep a list of accounts asking for local-currency invoicing

Actions:
- Dev: prepare a cutover plan for review
- Helen: model cash-flow impact of two providers running in parallel for one cycle
- Lena: circulate these notes

Danke,
Lena Fischer
Ops & Office Manager, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Notes: Leadership meeting 10 March
messages.body:
Quick recap of my concern from yesterday, so it does not get lost:

1. Whatever cutover date we pick, it cannot land inside the v3 launch window. 2. I would like the shadow billing cycle to run against real (non-production) customer segments first, not all accounts at once. 3. If either of those cannot be honoured, product would rather wait until after launch.

Thanks!
Priya

messages.subject: RE: Notes: Leadership meeting 10 March
messages.body:
ledgerly. dev pls plan cutover.

priya - agreed, nothing inside the launch window.

M
Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: RE: Notes: Leadership meeting 10 March
messages.body:
On it. First pass: start the Ledgerly sandbox work next week, shadow cycle across one full billing run, target cutover 1 May with Priya's constraint respected (that puts it before the launch window tightens). Will circulate a proper plan by Friday.

Cheers, Dev
